flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: The member is bound by a new 12-month term at a possibly higher rate without signing anything, and the same rollover repeats every year.

flags.sourceSentence: To stop a renewal you must deliver written notice of cancellation to the Member Services desk no later than three (3) days before the renewal date.
flags.consequence: Missing the 3-day notice deadline commits the member to a full additional 12-month term at the then-current rate, and a late notice pushes the cancellation to the end of the following term with all intervening dues payable.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: The member can be bound by new fees, rules, hours, and contract terms — including higher dues — without signing anything or receiving individual notice beyond a posting.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: If Meridian's conduct injures you or damages your property, its total liability is capped at the dues and fees you paid in the prior 12 months, and it is not liable at all for property loss (including lockers) or for indirect losses such as lost income — so a serious injury claim could be limited to roughly one year of membership fees.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The member must pay Meridian's legal fees and any third-party losses arising from their own use of the facilities, their conduct, their guests' conduct, or even informal services provided to another member, and cannot settle a covered claim without Meridian's consent.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after the member's Program candidacy ends for any reason, they cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness or personal training — as employee, contractor or on their own account — at any facility within 15 miles of any Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The member gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, and must resolve any dispute — however serious — in individual, final and binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.
flags.consequence: The membership keeps renewing on its original schedule even while suspended, frozen or on medical hold, so dues for the intervening term can come due while the member is not using the club.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Dues can rise once per year by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, and the member must monitor that email address to see the increase.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: The member's payment method is charged continuously for dues, tuition and all charges until the agreement ends and the balance is nil, with no stated end to the authorisation itself.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program tuition renews automatically each year at the then-current rate, and the member must give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary to stop it; missing the window means another full year of tuition.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: The member is responsible for every entry made with their keycard or account, so unauthorised use of their card or account could result in charges or rule violations attributed to them.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Anything the signer leaves on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames, tools — becomes the Association's property, to keep or throw away, with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to another full twelve-month term at whatever the annual fee is at that time.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: If the service fails — including losing the signer's work or a failed export — the most the signer can recover is the fee paid for the single Billing Period in which the problem occurred, which may be far less than the value of lost work or revenue.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's legal costs and any damages if a third party sues over content the signer uploaded, exported or published through the service — an open-ended obligation that could exceed anything the signer paid for the subscription.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue in court or join a class action against Northwind; disputes are decided by a single arbitrator whose award is final, with only small-claims court preserved.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: The provider can suspend the signer's account, cutting off access to their work, based only on its own belief that more than one person is using the credentials — with no stated notice or appeal process before the suspension takes effect.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: The provider can raise the signer's price at any time, and the new fee automatically applies from the next Billing Period unless the signer cancels — the signer cannot lock in their rate for the life of the subscription.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: If a payment fails — including because a stored card simply expired — interest of 1.5% per month accrues on the unpaid amount, and reactivating a suspended account carries an unspecified charge set by the provider's Fee Schedule, which the provider can change at any time.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: The subscription renews automatically every period and the signer is billed again unless they cancel before the period ends; a cancellation made even one day into a new period still bills and holds the whole period's fee with no refund.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: The provider can change any term of the agreement — including pricing and the Fee Schedule — at any time just by posting it, and the signer is bound by the new version simply by continuing to use the service, with no individual notice required for terms other than fees.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If monthly availability falls below 99.5%, the signer's only remedy is a service credit defined in a separate policy the provider controls and can amend at any time — no refund or other compensation is available for downtime.

flags.sourceSentence: Closing an account stops future Billing Periods and does not refund a Billing Period already begun.
flags.consequence: If the signer closes their account mid-period, or a monthly cancellation lands after the period starts, they lose the entire fee for the Billing Period already begun even if they stop using the service immediately.

flags.sourceSentence: We may list your organisation’s name in the customer list on our website, and we will remove it within ten working days of your asking us to.
flags.consequence: The provider can display the signer's organisation name publicly as a customer, and the signer has no way to opt out in advance — removal happens only after the signer asks, up to ten working days later.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends, the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the 'Restricted Field' (defined in Exhibit B, not provided), in any capacity, potentially leaving them unable to work in their specialism in the covered geography and industry.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses and attorney fees arising from alleged breaches of the confidentiality or non-compete sections, or from a former employer's claim about obligations owed to it — an open-ended financial exposure.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to go to court with a jury, and the right to join a class, collective or representative action, for any employment-related claim including statutory claims — disputes must go to individual arbitration instead.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: The signer must repay the entire $15,000 signing payment within 30 days of their last working day if they resign or are fired for cause within the first 12 months — even if the resignation is for reasons outside their control.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can change or withdraw any policy, benefit, or term described in the offer — including compensation-related plan terms — at any time without the signer's agreement, with the intranet version governing from publication.

flags.sourceSentence: You confirm that you are not subject to any obligation to a former employer that would prevent you from performing this role, and that you will not bring to Ardent or use in your work any confidential information belonging to anyone else.
flags.consequence: The signer cannot use or bring any confidential information from a former employer, and confirms no prior obligations conflict with the role — a breach could expose them to the indemnity in Section 6 and to claims from the former employer.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: If the occupant cannot produce evidence of insurance on request, they bear the entire risk of loss of their stored property, and even with insurance the operator's liability for any loss or damage — including damage caused by the operator's own negligence — is capped at $5,000 unless a higher value was declared and a fee paid.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay for the operator's legal defence and any third-party claims arising from use of the unit, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant lets onto the premises, with no cap on the amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: Unpaid rent or charges give the operator a lien over everything in the unit, allowing it to block access, overlock the unit, and after the legally required notice period sell the occupant's contents and keep the proceeds against what is owed.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The operator can raise the monthly rent on 30 days' written notice, and the occupant's only alternative to paying the higher rate is to end the agreement and move out.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late rent and each follow-up notice about an unpaid balance trigger charges whose amounts are not in this document but in a separate schedule the operator can post and change, so the occupant cannot know the full cost from this agreement alone.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The operator can change the gate hours, the posted rules, and the terms of this agreement itself simply by posting notice at the facility and emailing the occupant's last known address, with the changes binding from the first day of the following month.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the occupant moves out during a month, the rent already paid for that month is kept by the operator with no refund, so leaving mid-month means paying for the full month.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself automatically every month without any fresh signature or confirmation, so it continues indefinitely until the occupant actively ends it under Section 8.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: At the end of a twelve-month promotional plan, the service automatically renews for another full twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate, unless the signer cancels the renewal before the last day of the current term.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a promotional plan before its term ends does not end the device instalment plan, and the entire unpaid instalment balance becomes due immediately on the next bill.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, and must resolve disputes in individual binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge that are not government-required, and Cascade can introduce, increase or remove either on notice given with the bill where the change first appears.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance incurs a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance each bill period until paid, and restoring a suspended line costs the restoral charge in the Rate and Charge Guide.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term of the agreement, any charge, and any feature of the rate plan on notice, and continued use of the service after the change's effective date counts as accepting it.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim is limited to the service charges for the affected line during the single bill period in which the claim arose, with no recovery for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising from use of the service, content sent from or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, or any charge incurred on the account.

flags.sourceSentence: Data speeds on an unlimited plan may be reduced after you use the monthly priority allowance shown on your Service Summary, and reduced speeds continue until the next bill period starts.
flags.consequence: On an unlimited plan, data speeds are reduced once the monthly priority allowance is used, and the reduced speeds last until the next bill period starts.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: On cancelling a line, charges accrue to the end of the bill period and the partial period is not prorated, so the signer pays for the full period even if service ends early in it.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme at any point for any reason on only one week's notice, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the terms of the agreement itself — including stipend terms, assessments and schedules — at any time by email, with the change taking effect immediately from the date of the email, before the Analyst has any chance to object or negotiate.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any paid or unpaid role — employee, contractor or intern — with any firm on the Restricted List, and cannot approach clients whose files they worked on, which could block a significant share of near-term job options in the sector.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay the Firm's legal costs and any claim, loss or expense arising from a breach of the confidentiality or non-compete clauses, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients — an open-ended amount that could include the Firm's reasonable legal costs.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action; any dispute must go to individual binding arbitration, removing court litigation and group claims as routes to contest a serious problem.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: Any housing advance instalment not recovered within ten days of its due date accrues a late charge, set in the Programme Handbook, until the advance is repaid in full — and the charge amount is not stated in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The confidentiality obligation covers every client name, model, memorandum and data set the Analyst sees and never expires, so the Analyst carries an indefinite restriction and exposure to the indemnity in Section 6 for any breach, however long after the Programme.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: The Analyst is charged the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook for any issued item — laptop, security token or building pass — not returned within five working days, and the Handbook amounts are not stated in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee. After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: The signer can lose part or all of the $120 fee if they give up the place: only half the fee is returned if they cancel after the seven-day window but before the third lesson, and nothing is returned after the third lesson has taken place.
